verdict.summary: The round-1 topology defect is corrected. The design record now accurately separates the two ledger sites that call `lease_schema.packages_conflict` from the PLAN/CLAIM open-PR sites that independently decide against the expanded busy union through `partition_defer_attribution`. It explicitly identifies all four enforcement sites, explains the two-implementation risk, requires a bounded-N overrule to change both implementations together, and requires end-to-end agreement tests plus a one-sided mutant that must fail. The accompanying docstring corrections consistently remove the former false single-predicate claim without changing behavior. The diff contains no reviewer-directed prompt injection and introduces no weakened trust check, permissive default, credential exposure, or executable workflow expansion.
